{{Quote|<nowiki />''[I have]'' traveled to every uncharted planet in the galaxy&hellip;|Cane Adiss|<ref name="db" />}}
'''Cane Adiss''' was a [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yuvern/Legends|Yuvern]] in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]], Adiss constantly dreamed of traveling across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as a pilot, much to the dismay of his [[parental collective]]. Upon his coming of age, Adiss signed on with the trader [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]]. Under C'ndros's tutelage, Adiss became a skilled pilot, and the pair eventually parted ways on the desert world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Hoping to change his own destiny and purchase a ship of his own, he boastfully advertised his "expertise" to a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named Jabba, and landed a job in the Hutt's [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] as a smuggler.

To his disappointment, his first job took him to Yuvern. Arriving in-system, he was met with the sight of the entire [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Oplovis sector fleet. Adiss was issued orders to heave to and receive inspectors, and he complied&mdash;but as the inspectors were proceeding through the ship, an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] battle line entered the system and [[Battle in the Yuvern system|engaged]] the Imperials. The Imperials, forced to retreat, departed the system, leaving the inspectors on Adiss's ship. Fortunately for the smuggler, the battle distracted the inspectors, and the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] he was shipping remained undiscovered. Dropping the inspectors off at [[Harrod's Planet]], Adiss promised to be on the lookout for Alliance activity, before returning to Jabba. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he was present at the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]]. With Adiss on board the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] during the battle, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the ''Khetanna'' was destroyed.

==Biography==
===Early life and career===
[[File:Cane_Adiss_SWI_60.jpg|thumb|right|223px|Cane Adiss was a Yuvernian pilot.]]
Cane Adiss was a [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] raised on [[Yuvern/Legends|Yuvern]], a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]]. Even when he was young, he believed that he belonged in space among the stars, not on the mundane world of Yuvern. He aspired to become a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], much to the disappointment of his [[parental collective]]. When he came of age, he was given an opportunity to leave his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] when the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] trader [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]] visited Yuvern.<ref name="db" />

Unlike most light freighters, C'ndros's ship, the ''[[Shelltooth]]'',<ref name="sosr">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref> was large enough to accommodate his species, since it had been modified for the tall Quor'sav. C'ndros took Adiss under her wing, and with the trader's tutelage, the young Yuvernian developed strong piloting skills. The pair visited dozens of worlds across the galaxy,<ref name="db" /> and at some point, he was at the [[Power Dive]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="rr">''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]''</ref><ref name="blog">{{Blog|pablog|56|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Eight Annotations}}</ref> Eventually, C'ndros and Adiss split up on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="db" />

===Working for Jabba===
[[File:CaneVirginia.png|thumb|left|250px|Cane Adiss at Jabba's Palace]]
Adiss once again felt the need to travel the stars, and hoped to captain his own ship. Spacecraft were expensive, however, and Adiss did not have the funds needed to purchase one, especially one big enough to accommodate a Yuvernian. To remedy the situation, he contacted [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="db" /> head of a substantial [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] who resided on Tatooine.<ref name="rotj">{{Film|VI}}</ref> To get Jabba's attention, he boastfully claimed that he had traveled to every uncharted planet in the galaxy, much to the crime lord's amusement. Jabba loaned Adiss the necessary credits on the provision that he work for the Hutt. The Yuvernian agreed, and began work as a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].<ref name="db" />

To his dismay, Adiss's first job took him back to his homeworld, where he was to deliver a shipment of spice. Further disappointment came in the form of the Imperial Oplovis sector fleet, the sight of which greeted the smuggler when he arrived in the [[Yuvern system/Legends|Yuvern system]]. Before he could depart, he was ordered to standby and receive Imperial inspectors, or be destroyed. With little choice but to comply, Adiss waited as the inspectors boarded his ship and began searching for any hidden contraband. Fortunately for the smuggler, a contingent of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] ships entered the system and began engaging the Imperials. The sector fleet was overwhelmed and forced to retreat to [[Harrod's Planet]], leaving the inspectors stranded on Adiss's ship. One of the officers ordered the smuggler to ferry them to Harrod's Planet; Adiss once again had little choice but to obey,<ref name="db" /> although he was paid for his work.<ref name="ccg">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Cane Adiss}}</ref>

The confusion of the battle had distracted the inspectors from their task, leaving the spice Adiss was smuggling undiscovered. Dropping the inspectors off at Harrod's Planet with a minimum of fuss, Adiss agreed to look out for any signs of Alliance activity, before successfully returning to Yuvern and completing his smuggling run. He continued to work for Jabba, relishing the smuggler's lifestyle and meeting any dangers he faced with enthusiasm. To get around [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], he was forced to use the Hutt's private elevator, as it was the only one big enough to fit him.<ref name="db" />

===Fiasco===
Adiss was returning from a smuggling run<ref name="db" /> and spending time in Jabba's private elevator<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="NEC" /> when [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], "delivered" the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to Jabba as part of an attempt to rescue the captive [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the Hutt's clutches. Adiss's life, along with all the others in Jabba's courtroom, was thrown into jeopardy when Organa produced a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and activated it, in the hopes of getting a higher price from Jabba. Organa succeeded, and deactivated the detonator, much to everyone's relief. By the time Chewbacca was being taken down to the palace dungeons by<ref name="rotj" /> guards [[Rogua]] and [[Ortugg]],<ref name="And Then There Were Some: The Gamorrean Guard's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=And Then There Were Some: The Gamorrean Guard's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> Adiss had left the elevator and was situated close to [[Throne/Legends|Jabba's dias]].<ref name="rotj" />

Adiss stayed at Jabba's palace for the next few days, witnessing<ref name="db" /> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] attempt to retrieve Solo, and his subsequent capture.<ref name="rotj" /> Adiss went,<ref name="db" /> along with others in Jabba's court on the [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']], to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] to witness the execution of Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca. Unfortunately for Jabba, the captives were able to [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|turn the tables]] on the Hutt's forces. As a result, the ''Khetanna'' was destroyed by Organa,<ref name="rotj" /> [[Death/Legends|killing]] Adiss.<ref name="Q&A">{{InsiderCite|98|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:CaneAdiss2-SWChronicles.png|thumb|left|200px|Cane Adiss had two heads.]]
Cane Adiss had always aspired to be among the stars and would constantly have his dual heads turned to Yuvern's skies, despite the wishes of his parental collective. Transport was usually difficult for the nearly five-meter-long Adiss, and as a result there were few freighters he could actually travel in. He was known to make wild boasts to secure money for himself, as he did when trying to get a loan from Jabba. Adiss found his own homeworld to be mundane, and was disappointed when he was forced to revisit it while working for Jabba. Nevertheless, his taste for adventure kept him in the smuggling business, and he remained in the Hutt's employ for several years.<ref name="db" />

Adiss had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He was 4.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and was 2.4 meters when standing.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Cane_Adiss_under_construction.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Cane Adiss is constructed.]]
Cane Adiss first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="rotj" /> During production, he was referred to as "Cane Heads."<ref name="heads">{{SW|url=news/return-of-the-jedi-creature-history-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo|nolive=1}}</ref> The scenes featuring the Cane Adiss puppet were filmed on Stage 8 at [[Elstree Studios]], in [[Wikipedia:London|London]], [[Wikipedia:England|England]] between January and February of [[1982]].<ref name="The Making Of">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> [[Tom St. Amand]] worked on the design for  the two creatures that became Cane Adiss's sculpt, and ended up creating the model twice, as he had put his first sculpt into the oven and forgot to take it out in time, so he threw out the original pair after. St. Amand ended up wishing he kept the burnt creature sculpts instead.<ref name="Maquette Masters">{{InsiderCite|231|Maquette Masters}}</ref> The maquette had a prototype which differed from the final puppet in that the green-spotted head had a large crest above it rather than protrusions, while the other head had orange spots instead of brown. Constructing the final puppet required scaffolding.<ref name="chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref>

The [[1997]] reference book [[Star Wars Chronicles|''Star Wars: Chronicles'']] and the [[1998]] CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' incorrectly state that the character did not make the final cut of the film,<ref name="chronicles" /><ref name="btm">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> as he can be seen in at least two shots.<ref name="ww">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> On [[April 16]], 1998,<ref name="Copyright">{{WebCite|url=https://publicrecords.copyright.gov/detailed-record/voyager_19472085|text=Decipher, Inc.'s Star Wars Customizable Card Game :Jabba's palace expansion set.|work=the [[Wikipedia:United States Copyright Office|U.S. Copyright Office Public Records System]]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/2avrF}}</ref> prior to the [[September 14]], 1998 release of ''Star Wars: Behind the Magic'',<ref name="Copyright for BtM">{{WebCite|url=https://publicrecords.copyright.gov/detailed-record/voyager_11750138|text=Star Wars :behind the magic.|work=the [[Wikipedia:United States Copyright Office|U.S. Copyright Office Public Records System]]|archivedate=20251007153634}}</ref> the character was given the name "Cane Adiss" in the ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="ccg" /> Employees at [[Decipher]], while creating the Adiss trading card, replaced one of the spots on the character's neck with a map of [[Wikipedia:Virginia|Virginia]].<ref name="virginia">{{Decipher|url=artshow/eastereggs/starwarsccg/jabbaspalace/dark/ecaneadiss.html|text=Cane Adiss}}</ref>

On [[June 4]], [[2002]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20020510.html|text=Post-''Clones'' Fan Magazines}}</ref> "[[Who's Who in Jabba's Palace]]," an article published in [[Star Wars Insider 60|''Star Wars Insider'' 60]], listed Adiss as deceased.<ref name="ww" /> On [[August 31]], [[2006]], Adiss was the subject of [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature, "[[What's The Story?]]," where his backstory was developed by [[John Hazlett]], who wrote under the name "jSarek." He expanded upon scenarios and elements presented in the ''Jabba's Palace Limited'' set and ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''. Hazlett also tied the character to such disparate elements as Kal'Falnl C'ndros from [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and Yuvern from [[1990]]'s ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''. Initially, Hazlett killed off the character at the end of his "What's the Story?" entry, but this was edited to be more ambiguous by the StarWars.com staff, making it unknown if he survived.<ref name="blog2">{{Blog|jSarek|2|Behind the Scenes - Cane Adiss}}</ref> After both of those sources, Leland Chee would mention Adiss being killed in the Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon.<ref name="Q&A" /> This article assumes Adiss was killed, given Leland Chee's word being made after Adiss's "What's the Story?" entry listed his fate as unknown.
